fallos_mitigaciones: Unbounded context growth in long-running agents causes degraded LLM performance, escalating API costs, and eventual context-window overflow (S3.3); mitigated via the Two-Tier Constant-Size Memory bounded at ~5,000 chars with LOSSY-BY-DESIGN auto-compaction (oldest milestone entries dropped past 1,200 chars; only 15 most-recent decisions retained) -- explicitly described as mirroring how humans forget routine details while keeping key milestones. Separately, the mandatory pre-launch dry-run catches 18% of planned experiments before wasting GPU hours (config mistakes, missing imports, tensor-shape mismatches, S4.2).

fallos_mitigaciones: Central failure mode: superficial surface-similarity retrieval (identical stack traces/errors/paths) actively misleads the agent onto an incorrect repair branch, consuming context budget on 'confidently wrong' fixes (S1, 5 concrete real-repo failure pairs e.g. SQLite-lock-vs-stale-migration, wrong-venv-vs-wrong-PYTHONPATH); mitigated via the risk-sensitive reward (gamma>alpha>beta, false-positive penalty 4x the accepted-reuse bonus, Eq.12-13) that makes abstention/no-memory first-class safety actions rather than fallback states, achieving 0.0% false-positive rate in both offline replay and bounded hot-path validation (S3).
